sloka: अथ चेत् सत्यवचनं धर्मः किल परन्तप।अनृतस्त्वय्यकरुणः किं न बद्धस्त्वया पिता ।। ६.८३.२८ ।।
transliteration: atha cet satyavacanaṁ dharmaḥ kila parantapa।anṛtastvayyakaruṇaḥ kiṁ na baddhastvayā pitā ।। 6.83.28 ।।

translations.english: "O scorcher of enemies! If you consider speaking the truth is dharma, why did you not bind your father (who promised to give the kingdom) and was not compassionate (spoke untruth later)."
